title.zh-Hant: 孕早期快結束了：先把這 4 件事排進行事曆
title.en: The first trimester is almost over: put these 4 things on your calendar

summary.zh-Hant: 流感疫苗任何孕期都能打；約第 20 週照解剖超音波；24–28 週驗妊娠糖尿病；27–36 週打百日咳疫苗。每個時間都有理由。
summary.en: Flu shot any trimester; anatomy ultrasound around week 20; gestational diabetes screening in weeks 24–28; Tdap in weeks 27–36. Each timing has a reason.

q.zh-Hant: 懷孕可以打噴鼻式流感疫苗嗎？
q.en: Can you get the nasal spray flu vaccine while pregnant?

a.zh-Hant: 不行，要打注射型；而且任何孕期都可以打。
a.en: No. Get the shot, which is fine in any trimester.

q.zh-Hant: 第 20 週左右的超音波主要看什麼？能抓到所有問題嗎？
q.en: What does the week-20 ultrasound look at, and does it catch everything?

a.zh-Hant: 看寶寶的構造（心臟、腎臟、四肢等）。不能，大約只能發現一半的異常。
a.en: The baby's anatomy (heart, kidneys, limbs and more). No: it finds about half of abnormalities.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼妊娠糖尿病篩檢排在 24–28 週？
q.en: Why is gestational diabetes screening done in weeks 24–28?

a.zh-Hant: 懷孕荷爾蒙造成的胰島素阻抗越來越明顯，妊娠糖尿病通常在第 24 週左右才出現。
a.en: Insulin resistance from pregnancy hormones builds up, and gestational diabetes usually appears around week 24.

q.zh-Hant: Tdap 為什麼每一胎都要打？
q.en: Why is Tdap given in every pregnancy?

a.zh-Hant: 它的作用是讓媽媽在出生前把抗體傳給這一個寶寶，每個寶寶都需要自己那一次。
a.en: Its job is to pass antibodies to this particular baby before birth, and each baby needs its own transfer.
